To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ATM network is a good candidate for transmission of multimedia traffic.

the traffic management of multimedia over an ATM network can be achieved by using the following: (1) a connection admission control scheme that is able to guarantee the required quality of service to the multimedia stream; (2) a congestion control scheme that is based on a leaky bucket algorithm and is capable of controlling the cell loss rate to the desired value; and (3) a flow control mechanism that is capable of controlling and regulating the flow of cells from the network to the destination.

the following three techniques are useful for the transmission of multimedia over ATM: 1) a new traffic model that takes into account the burstiness of multimedia traffic, 2) a new traffic shaping algorithm that uses this new model, and 3) a new traffic policing algorithm that also uses this new model.
